title: Algorithmic Foundations
blurb: Master Knuth's criteria, loop invariants, asymptotic Big-O/Omega/Theta notation, and amortized complexity.

title: Linear Data Structures
blurb: Understand contiguous arrays, dynamic resizing, singly and doubly linked lists, and circular buffers.

title: Stacks, Queues & Hash Tables
blurb: Explore LIFO/FIFO mechanics, monotonic stacks, collision resolution, open addressing, and load factor rehashing.

title: Recursion & Searching
blurb: Analyze call stack execution, recurrence relations, binary search invariants, and bisect search on answer spaces.

title: Sorting Algorithms
blurb: Master quadratic sorts, divide-and-conquer mergesort, randomized quicksort, and non-comparison linear sorts.

title: Trees & Heaps
blurb: Binary search tree invariants, AVL tree rebalancing, binary heap properties, and priority queue mechanics.

title: Graph Traversals & Connectivity
blurb: Graph representations, BFS and DFS traversals, topological sorting, DAG detection, and Disjoint Set Union.

title: Graph Optimization
blurb: Shortest paths with Dijkstra and Bellman-Ford, Minimum Spanning Trees with Kruskal and Prim, and cut properties.

title: Dynamic Programming
blurb: Memoization vs tabulation, subproblem DAGs, classic 1D/2D DP problems, and space optimization techniques.

title: Greedy & Backtracking
blurb: Greedy-choice properties, interval scheduling, state space tree exploration, pruning, and state restoration.

title: String Matching
blurb: Naive string scanning, KMP linear-time prefix matching, Rabin-Karp rolling hashes, and algorithm selection.
